ننقطع (form VII)
# نَنْقَطِعُ (nanqaṭiʕu) /nan.qa.tˤi.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْقَطَعَ (inqaṭaʕa)
# نَنْقَطِعَ (nanqaṭiʕa) /nan.qa.tˤi.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْقَطَعَ (inqaṭaʕa)
# نَنْقَطِعْ (nanqaṭiʕ) /nan.qa.tˤiʕ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْقَطَعَ (inqaṭaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
